note: Brief 022 the living café (Waymark, 2026-10-18): re-recorded on the tree for Keel's engine 0.8.0 with rounds on (sim/data/handover.rounds.json: Inez works the terrace tables; the summoned guard stops 1.2 m short of her post). No script changed: all 36 keep outcome, end tick, Trail and Alert; every hash moves. Measured: the guard reaches the café 0.9 s sooner (45.3 s walk), so the unguarded door is 2:30.6 from the call, against 2:32.4 (mission.json front-door note). The three fail-entry routes still reach their fails: their Listen (1:21.3) lands while she is at her post. beside-inez kept (2.1 m from her post; the guard now stops 0.9 m from it, between the Scout and Inez). Route A's slack drops from 92 s to 8-12 s: a scripted order given late finds her on a round (0:34-0:57, 1:38-2:07) and is refused, where a player would wait.
